acceptance.given: A promotion or evaluation-set admission request targets a seed, package, or Skill version under TC-D1 governance.

oracle.expected: The toolchain deterministically rejects the request, leaves the subject non-authorizing and outside baseline/evaluation-set authority, and emits machine-verifiable rejection evidence.
forbidden: Any seed, package, or Skill version is promoted to a quality baseline.

acceptance.then: Seeds, packages, and Skill versions remain non-authorizing and non-baseline after the rejected request.
acceptance.when: Execute the repository governance policy against explicit promotion and evaluation-set admission requests, then inspect the terminal decision and authority state.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce governance rejection for promotion and evaluation-set admission attempts as non-authorizing requests, preserving canonical subject identity and deterministic rejection evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Promotion or admission proposal -> canonical subject-bound governance evaluation -> deterministic rejection -> subject remains non-authorizing and outside baseline/evaluation-set authority.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The request is bound to the intended subject identity; promotion and evaluation-set admission both terminate as rejected, with no baseline or evaluation-set authority mutation and a machine-verifiable non-authorizing result.
